scouting.summary: Uses a jab and an overhand to get close, then shoots the double leg and grinds on top.
strengths: Big gas tank and heavy top control
weaknesses: Has to change levels to shoot, and you can see it coming
scouting.tell: He shifts his stance just before he shoots the double leg.
scouting.how_to_beat: Watch for the stance shift and sprawl. Make him strike with you on the feet.
